one_liner: Aircall has a broad REST API with self-serve Basic Auth API keys for any customer account; OAuth is limited to Tech Partners; an official read-only beta MCP exists but needs beta enrollment and the AI add-on.
auth_notes: Basic Auth uses api_id:api_token generated in the dashboard (per-customer). OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow is for multi-customer apps, but client_id/client_secret come from Aircall after a partner form/Tech Partner program, so it is not self-serve.
access_notes: Any Aircall customer account can generate API keys with no review (Private App). The homepage offers 'Try for Free', suggesting a trial, but its length and whether the API works in it are not shown. No free tier is evidenced. The Messaging API needs the Professional plan. Aircall does not publicly state which plans include API access (third-party review).
blocker_notes: Basic Auth keys work with an Aircall account, which likely needs a trial or paid plan (trial terms unverified). Multi-user OAuth needs Tech Partner approval, so a multi-tenant OAuth toolkit is gated by that program; per-customer Basic keys are workable. The official MCP is read-only, beta, and needs beta enrollment via account manager plus the AI add-on.

evidence.quote: Aircall will generate two strings: an `API ID`and an `API token`, which act as your username and password.
OAuth credentials — If you haven't received them yet, apply to the [Tech Partner program]
Before starting building the OAuth flow for your app, you will need to get OAuth client_id and client_secret from Aircall.
A Private App is built for a single Aircall account. It's the fastest way to get started — no review process, no marketplace listing, and no OAuth flow required.
Aircall does not publicly state which plan tiers include API access or whether API calls are metered.
Aircall Public API is a classic REST API. It can be used with any programming languages
We are also supporting **Webhooks**. We can call back any endpoint of your choice, each time an event occurs on an Aircall account
This feature is in beta, so your account needs to be enrolled in the **beta** **program.**
